---
slug: a_bad_day_for_everyone
title: A Bad Day for Everyone
blurb: Non-canon. Sanya drags a leashed, collared Emmett out of the ship on a "special mission" to a roadside diner, with a suspicious Garrick trailing behind.
authors: Brody
season: FF3
format: prose
---

Within the depths of the bruhium Pummeler, Sanya was making her way back from the temple. Despite having a fun time with Mary, she still was upset about having to come back to the crew. The moment she stepped foot back in her room, she smelled a familiar stench—her favorite Squoatling. She had forgotten she tied Emmett to her headrest via his leash. She loved to mess with him, and this whole leash idea was great. The Squoatling, of course, was fast asleep on the floor like the dog he was.

"[Good night, Emmett]{Sanya Dreadflower}," Sanya softly whispered, giving him a kick to the groin in a compassionate way. The Squoatling immediately woke up in pain.

"[FUCK, SANYA. I WANT TO HAVE KIDS!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He immediately jumped at her, but the leash was extremely tight, and he gagged himself as she backed away. As he fell back down, he held his privates intensely.

"[My bad. I didn’t think you’d wake up. However, I’m glad you did. I need your help.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"

"[Can you pleeeeease take off this leash? It makes me feel uncomfortable.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Sorry, but I need you to keep it on. I need you to pass as my pet.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett shivered, definitely not wanting to partake in makeup sessions or shopping.

"[Sanya, I'm not going to go with you to the mall.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[We’re not going to the mall, Emmett. This is a special mission, and I need you to be with me for it. But, to do that, you need to act like my pet.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett sat there, clearly unamused by the possible embarrassment.

"[Do I really look like a pet?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett unconsciously was doing his puppy eyes thing.

"[When we first met, I thought you were a pet. Now come on, and put this on.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" She tossed a collar at his horns, the collar ringing perfectly around one of them.

“[Is this a shock collar?]{Emmett Tawfeek}” Emmett was concerned for his well-being. He wouldn’t put it past Sanya.

Garrick passed by, hearing the commotion. “[Sanya, you’re like a head of cabbage.]{Garrick}”

"[Should Garrick join us on our wondrous journey?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett checked the shock collar out, noticing the odd intricate designs engraved within it. "[Also, I don't have to be on all fours, right? And, we're not going into GU territory, right? They definitely know what a Squoatling is. If I was a pet, I'd also have to be unclothed, realistically. Hope we're not going somewhere cold]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett replied quickly.

“[Emmett, just shut up, put on the collar, and strip. We need to get going, and if you don’t, I'll keep that collar on you for another week.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Emmett sighed promptly.

“[What’s this about a journey? What are you two scheming?]{Garrick}”

“[Nothing to concern yourself about, Ghost. We were just leaving. Right, Emmett?]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Emmett, wanting to be a bother to Sanya, refused.

"[What if I liked having the collar on? Huh, Sanya? How about that?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[Emmett, if you ever feel like you’re in danger, yell “GARRICK MOMENT” and I’ll be there in no time.]{Garrick}”

“[If you like the collar, you’ll love this mission. Let’s get going.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya pulled on the leash attached to Emmett’s collar, tugging her new pet out of the room.

"[Let me strip down, sheesh]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett choked as he was dragged out of the room, tossing off his clothing. "[As I said, I hope it isn't cold. I hate the cold.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Garrick raised an invisible eyebrow, feeling a little uncertain about their escapade. He decided to follow them to make sure Emmett stayed safe. Sanya must have been insane, he thought.

Sanya dragged Emmett to the cockpit. She had never set the autopilot herself before, but she was damn well determined to figure it out. “[So many buttons…]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya presses a bunch of the buttons randomly, and Emmett feels extremely infuriated by this.

"[Please don't touch her there if you don't know what you're doing.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[This is my adventure. My rules. Now tell me what to press.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett pointed directly to the button labeled "AUTO PILOT".

"[Make sure you put in the coordinates correctly.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

“[I will, I will. Don’t worry about a thing, Emmett. Just sit there and be cute, like a good boy.]{Sanya Dreadflower}”

"[Sanya, are you alright? You aren't acting right.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett sits in his pilot's seat, casually manspreading.

"[Emmett, close your legs or I'll slap your nuts.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett rolled his eyes and closed his legs.

"[Fine.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Within a few minutes, the ship started to accelerate in a seemingly random direction. Sanya was excited that she finally was able to direct the ship in her favor.

"[Thankfully, I can stop with this charade once we meet up]{Sanya Dreadflower}," Sanya muttered to herself.

15 minutes pass. The ship finally makes it to the ‘meeting spot’. A small diner overtakes the view of the cockpit, a remnant of ancient times, seemingly thrust to the present.

“[Here we are. Break and Bake. Come on, doggy. We’re heading inside.]{Sanya Dreadflower}” Sanya tugged the leash again, leading him through the ship. She was crushing his windpipe with how tight she made his leash.

"[S-Sans… Sanya… My throat!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett croaked. Sanya ignored him, making her way to the meeting place. As she walked through the diner’s doors, she glanced over to the corner booth. Looking directly at her were all of the girls in the crew, along with a mystery woman. They waved frantically.

"[Hello, Sanya!]{Iris}" exclaimed Iris.

"[Hey, plant]{Volentina Constantini}," said Valentina. The other girls greeted her as well, but those two voices in particular were the most prominent. They almost completely ignored the fact that Emmett was on a leash held by Sanya.

"[I got myself a pet for the occasion, just like you asked!]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Sanya rolled her eyes, the false sweetness dripping from her words.

"[Did he come here willingly? His throat looks constrained]{Mary}," said the mystery woman. Sanya proceeded to loosen the collar with a shrug, clearly no longer interested in the Squoatling. Emmett held his throat, choking at the table. Apparently the mysterious figure was the only one worried about him.

"[Is he okay?]{Mary}"

“[Yeah, he should be fine. I think he likes it. Then again, it wasn’t my idea to use Emmett as a pet. It was Jess's.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett raised an eyebrow, clearly confused. He tried to speak, but only a bleat came out.

“[I said I heard him muttering about collars in his sleep, Sanya.]{Jessica}”

“[I needed a pet, he apparently likes collars. Win-Win.]{Sanya Dreadflower}”

"[Can you please take him home? We can pay the extra fee. It's no problem, really.]{Mary}"

"[Fine. I'll let him go. I’ll be right back.]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Sanya got back up from the booth, leading Emmett with much more care than she had entered with. As soon as she walked outside, she unlocked the collar and threw it over her shoulder.

"[Go home. I'm s-ssss…]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Emmett held his hoof to his ear, implying that he wanted her to apologize.

"[I'm sorry]{Sanya Dreadflower}," she said in a low tone. Sanya immediately became angry at Emmett's smug look.

"[Scram. It's girls' night. You're not invited.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"

After overhearing this line, Iris transforms into Emmett and leaves. She is very uncomfortable with the situation and wishes to leave. The transformed Iris met up with the real Emmett outside and held out her hand.

"[I want to bake you into bread.]{Iris}"

“[NO! I DON’T WANNA BE BREAD! NO! NOOOO!!!]{Emmett Tawfeek}”

Emmett turned into bread for the time being.

All was lost.

At least, it was all gone until Iris pulled Emmett out of the bread.

Making absolutely sure that there were no guys involved, Sanya set fire to her head flower. As Dread burned alive, she started chanting loudly in a deep voice.

"[MAR-E-OH, EH-EH-EH.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"

Mary joined in soon after.

"[MAR-E-OH, EH-EH-EH.]{Mary}"

"[MAR-E-OH, EH-EH-EH.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"

"[MAR-E-OH, EH-EH-EH.]{Mary}"

"[MAR-E-OH, EH-EH-EH.]{Sanya Dreadflower}"
